Thank you all for those critical updates. Let me make sure I have the full picture before I record any decision.

Jonah, the $300,000 principal prepayment is a meaningful positive — I'll want that term sheet circulated and filed before execution.

Marcus, your stress test showing 1.18x DSCR is directly on point. Under our risk policy that permits a waiver but caps it at 90 days and requires a $75,000 fee. That gives me my duration and fee parameters.

Priyanka, good catch on the operations side. Since a 90-day waiver exceeds the 30-day threshold, the weekly financial reporting control is required as a matter of policy, and I'll make that a condition.

Nadia, your legal flag is the gating item. We cannot record a waiver decision — or execute one — until we secure written consent from the administrative agent. That is a hard precondition under the intercreditor agreement, and I will not proceed without it.

So my decision is: the waiver is approved in principle, subject to the following conditions — 90-day duration, $75,000 waiver fee, $300,000 principal prepayment upon execution, weekly financial reporting throughout the waiver period, and — critically — written consent from the administrative agent secured and filed before the waiver takes effect. Jonah, please circulate that term sheet to the full committee immediately. Nadia, please initiate the administrative agent consent process today. Priyanka, ensure the weekly reporting control is configured on the loan platform. I will record the formal committee decision once the agent consent is in hand.
